prereq.p: Ensure your HP large-format printer is powered on and connected to the network. Administrator rights are required on the host computer.

step.cmd: Navigate to hp.com/go/HPClick to download the HP Click installer.

info.p: Select the installer for your operating system: Windows 10/11 (64-bit) or macOS 12 or later. The download is free.

step.cmd: Run the downloaded installer (HPClickSetup.exe on Windows or HPClick.dmg on macOS).

info.p: On Windows, click Yes when prompted by User Account Control. On macOS, open the .dmg and drag HP Click to the Applications folder.

step.cmd: Launch HP Click after installation completes.

info.p: On first launch, HP Click scans the local network for supported HP printers. If your printer is not found automatically, click Add printer manually and enter the printer IP address.

step.cmd: Select your printer in HP Click and click Install driver when prompted.

info.p: This installs the HP Click virtual printer driver, adding a system-level printer entry. You can then print to HP Click from any application via File > Print.

step.cmd: Print a test file to confirm the HP Click Driver is working correctly.

info.p: Drag a PDF or JPEG file onto the HP Click window and click Print. Verify the job completes on the printer.

note.p: HP Click requires the printer and computer to be on the same local network subnet. If they are on different subnets, add the printer via its IP address manually.
Uninstall any previous version of HP Click before installing a new version to avoid driver conflicts.
